title: Nonlocal geometric rigidity inequalities and the justification of linearized peridynamics
summary: We prove geometric rigidity inequalities for vector fields using double-integral Gagliardo-type quantities. We show that the nonlocal-norm distance of the difference quotient of a vector field from the difference quotient of a single rigid motion is controlled by the same nonlocal norm of a difference characterizing the distance to the manifold of all rigid motions. The inequality is then used to show the variational convergence of a sequence of rescaled nonlocal fully nonconvex integral functionals to a linearized energy functional.
